answer.thought: The body protests the neglect of the last twenty-four hours; the spirit, however, refuses to be defined by the empty stomach. I sit in the stillness of the bungalow, allowing the heat to settle, for even in this suspension of the ethical life, the individual must maintain a semblance of dignity. The file is gone, the pot is dry, and the sun lingers with the indifference of a master who has forgotten his servant.
